previous.changeLog:
Actionable, self-clearing done ticks — a researched module tick now buys and mounts the module and clears itself; field-mod done ticks clear when you open the screen.
Estimated battles remaining — tooltips now show an ≈ M–N battles estimate beside the XP shortfall, calibrated from your best-game pace and average, with reserve/first-win bonuses factored in.

current.changeLog:
Fixed a phantom Potential Tier XI bar. Tier-X vehicles whose Tier XI successor you have already researched no longer show a stray "potential" bar.
Fixed the Tier XI skill-tree "done" marker. Completing the upgrade tree now correctly turns the chip into its green done marker even when there's no remaining frontier.
Fixed the saved bar position drifting between resolutions. The bar's position is no longer stored as raw pixels, so it stays where you put it when your screen resolution or window size changes. (Existing setups: use Reset if the bar lands off-screen.)
Smoother hovering and no more stale tooltips. Reduced per-frame work while hovering the bar, and tooltips no longer linger after the underlying tick changes.

previous.changeLog: Moved configuration storage to the persistent World of Tanks preferences folder, preventing settings loss during clean modpack installations.

current.changeLog: Fixed enemy vehicles incorrectly inheriting the player’s locally saved custom outfit for the same tank type. Custom outfits now apply only to the player’s own vehicle during battle.
